extraction_notes: Catalog seed identity is AP2300, ALLPOWER ShenZhen Quan Li Semiconductor, n-channel MOSFET; the supplied PDF prints AP2300 and N-Channel Power MOSFET on all three examined pages.

RDS(on) table rows are transcribed as separate typical and inclusive maximum points: 25 mOhm typical and 35 mOhm maximum at VGS = 2.5 V, ID = 5.2 A; 21 mOhm typical and 25 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 6 A.
The body-diode field uses the inclusive maximum VSD of 1.3 V; the table also publishes a typical value of 0.85 V under the same condition.
The supplied PDF has no capacitance-versus-VDS figure. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are transcribed from the table at VDS = 10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; no capacitance curve points were invented.
Fig. 2 is labeled Typical Transfer Characteristics but its y-axis is On Resistance rather than drain current. It is represented with its printed axes and condition IDS = 4.8 A, TC = 25 degC.

Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation. The VGS = 5 V, 8 V, and 10 V output traces are clipped by the 12 A plot ceiling and were not digitized as separate curves.
